items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: The other night we talked to Sammy Penn, the drummer who used to play with him too. ... I didn't know what he meant though, by his family.

ctx.x: And you'd put that all on the truck? Oh yeah. Whereabouts on the truck would you sit, Alan?
The first. First. First. First. Thank you.

The drummer would be right up near the driver then, the front end of the truck? Yes. The bass player would be on the end. Back at the tailgate. Yeah, tailgate. Him and the tri-roll. I was going to ask. Some more about Buddy Petit. The other night we talked to Sammy Penn, the drummer who used to play with him too. He talked like Buddy lived across the lake at the end of his life. Do you remember those days? Did he ever talk about going across the lake much? Buddy did go across the lake. He lost his health. That's…
